meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Read ひと when standing as an independent noun.

examples.text: 親切な人に会いました。

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').

examples.trans: You really are nimble with your hands.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.note: Ichidan verb; takes を or と.

examples.text: 季節の変化を感じます。
examples.trans: I feel the change of seasons.

examples.text: 少し高いと感じるかもしれません。
examples.trans: You may feel it's a little expensive.

meanings.note: Signals recognizing someone ('Oh, Toshi!') or letting out a feeling ('Man, I'm hungry').

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。

meanings.note: Opposite of 裏 (hidden side); also means 'outside/front'.

examples.text: 人間には表と裏がある。
examples.trans: Human beings have a public face and a hidden side.
Go outside / come into the open.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Calls someone's attention ('look here!') or asks for a brief pause (ちょっと待って).

examples.text: ちょっと待ってください。
ちょっと見てください。

meanings.note: て-form 待って + ください is 'please wait'; causative お待たせして means 'having kept you waiting'.
Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.
Used both to answer yes politely and when handing an item to someone.
Softens a refusal or correction at the start of a reply.
Very common colloquial pronunciation/variant of すみません.

examples.text: すいません、ちょっと通してください。
examples.trans: Excuse me, please let me through.

meanings.note: First-person pronoun commonly used by men and boys in friendly or polite everyday settings.

examples.text: 僕もコーヒーをください。

meanings.note: Attaches to pronouns or people nouns (僕ら, 彼ら).
Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

困る.gloss: be troubled; be in a bind

meanings.en: to be troubled; to be in a bind; to have difficulty
meanings.note: Godan verb.

examples.trans: That puts me in a bind.

examples.text: お金がなくて困っている。
examples.trans: I'm in trouble because I have no money.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Casual counterpart of こちら.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

examples.text: こっちは四百万以上も未納のままにされてんだぞ！
examples.trans: He's left over four million yen unpaid on our invoices!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Follows a number or quantity to indicate a lower bound (inclusive).

examples.text: 百万冊以上売れている。
examples.trans: Over a million copies are selling.
I waited more than ten minutes.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).
Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Reflexive pronoun pointing back to the person under discussion.

examples.text: 自分の言葉で話します。
examples.trans: I speak in my own words.

meanings.note: Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。
